note: What is being evaluated. The dataset says what it is fed and what right looks like; this says what produces the answer.

static_artifact.why: The prediction already exists, so the run compares rather than generates. Fast, offline, and reproducible - but it scores an artifact, not the running system.

harness_image.note: NOT USABLE YET: every ghcr.io/se04ber image is private (HTTP 403 anonymously), and REANA on C4P cannot pull it. Either publish one image or keep kind=static_artifact.

mcp_server.note: Reachable and authenticating. Covers routing and retrieval, NOT metadata suggestion - the ten MCP tools are read-only by design and there is no suggest tool on that surface.

metrics.note: The last group is what remains applicable when golden_label is absent - ALPS today. A metric needing a reference is simply not run rather than silently scoring against nothing.
